svg.aria-label: journal, DispatchAI: Grand Prize at the UC Berkeley AI Hackathon, June 2024. Sorts 911 calls by severity for understaffed call centers. After: Became Dispatch AI, $50K in funding. Built with: Mistral, Twilio, Hume, Retell. My part: Fine-tuning and the voice agent. Critical details such as location, time of emergency, and caller's emotions are collected from the live call. My commit 75485b7 at 5:23 AM on June 23, 2024: "TRNASFERS WPORKSASDASDASDASDASAD". The picture is a print of the 令旗 (Command Flag) from my site's forge, with a photo of the dispatcher screen.
